scripts.build: bun run build:main && bun run stage
scripts.dist: bun run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:publish: bun run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish always -c.publish.provider=github -c.publish.owner=durabullhq -c.publish.repo=durabull -c.publish.channel=latest
scripts.dist:dir: bun run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir --publish never
